blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Semantic segmentation networks operate on a fixed set of classes and therefore fail when out-of-distribution (OOD) objects appear during deployment, a critical limitation for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Reliably identifying OOD objects requires well-calibrated epistemic uncertainty, yet common softmax-based confidence scores remain overconfident, while Bayesian alternatives such as Monte Carlo dropout or deep ensembles require costly repeated forward passes. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) offers an efficient alternative by modeling class probabilities as a Dirichlet distribution learned from a single deterministic forward pass. Existing EDL formulations rely on Euclidean objectives that push predictions towards the simplex vertices, encouraging overconfidence rather than preserving uncertainty for unfamiliar inputs. We instead employ Wasserstein-based objectives, which respect the geometry of the probability simplex, and study the influence of the Wasserstein order on segmentation accuracy and OOD detection within a unified evidential framework. We evaluate this framework on a convolutional (DeepLabV3+) and a transformer-based (SegFormer) architecture on the SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark, including LostAndFound, RoadObstacle21, RoadAnomaly21, and Fishyscapes. Our results show the optimal Wasserstein order is architecture-dependent: second-order objectives dominate on the convolutional backbone, third-order objectives on the transformer backbone, and our framework surpasses comparable baselines on most metrics, with a single deterministic forward pass.
blocks.zh: 语义分解网络在一组固定的类别上运行,因此在部署期间出现分解出(OOD)物体时会失败,这是对自主驾驶等安全关键应用的关键限制. 可靠地识别出OD物体需要精确的感知不确定性,但基于软马克的常见信心分数仍然过于自信,而诸如蒙特卡洛辍学或深度综艺等巴耶斯式替代品则需要费用高昂的重复前行通行证. Evidicious Deep Learning(EDL)通过模拟班级概率作为Drichlet的分布,从单一的确定性前传中吸取了教训,从而提供了高效的替代品. 现有的EDL配方依赖于欧几利得目标,将预测推向简单的顶点,鼓励过度自信,而不是为不熟悉的投入保留不确定性. 我们采用了基于瓦瑟斯坦的目标,它们尊重概率简单x的几何学,并在一个统一的证据框架内研究瓦瑟斯坦命令对分解精度和OOD检测的影响. 我们对这个框架的评价是:一个进取式(DeepLabV3+)和一个基于变压器的(SegFormer)架构,在SeptMeIfYouCan基准上,包括LostAndFound, RoadObstacle21, RoadAnomaly21和Fishyscapes. 我们的结果显示,最理想的瓦瑟斯坦秩序是建筑依赖的:二等目标占据了革命骨干上,三等目标占据了变压器骨干上,我们的框架超过了大多数衡量标准上的可比基线,有一个单一的确定性前进通道.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have become the dominant paradigm for a wide range of computer vision tasks, including image classification [ 20 ] , object detection [ 43 ] , and semantic segmentation [ 10 ] . Semantic segmentation aims to assign a semantic class label to every pixel of an image, thereby enabling dense scene understanding. In safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving, semantic segmentation constitutes a fundamental component of the perception pipeline, providing detailed information about the surrounding environment and supporting downstream planning and decision-making processes. Well performing architectures, including DeepLabV3+ [ 10 ] and SegFormer [ 52 ] , have demonstrated strong performance on large-scale benchmarks and have significantly advanced the state-of-the-art in semantic scene understanding.
blocks.zh: 深神经网络(DNNs)成为了众多计算机视觉任务的主导范式,包括图像分类[20],物体检测[43],语义分解[10]. 语义分解旨在为图像的每个像素指定一个语义类标签,从而能使密集的场景理解. 在自主驾驶等安全关键领域,语义分解构成感知管道的基本组成部分,提供周围环境的详细资料并支助下游规划和决策过程. 表现良好的建筑包括DeepLabV3+ [10]和SegFormer [52],在大规模基准上表现出了强大的性能,并显著地推进了语义场景理解的最先进.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, DNNs remain fundamentally constrained by the data used during training. Semantic segmentation models are typically trained on large annotated datasets that represent only a limited subset of the visual variability encountered in real-world environments. As a result, objects, structures, or scene configurations that are absent from the training distribution may occur during deployment. Such observations are commonly referred to as out-of-distribution (OOD) samples [ 8 , 33 ] . When confronted with OOD objects, segmentation networks frequently exhibit a substantial degradation in performance and may assign highly confident but incorrect predictions to previously unseen content (see Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但DNN仍然受到培训期间使用的数据的根本制约. 语义分解模型通常在大型注解数据集上被培训,这些数据集只是现实世界环境中所遇到视觉可变性的有限子集. 因此,在部署期间,可能出现未参加训练分发的物体、结构或场景配置。 这类观测通常被称为分流外样本[8,33]. 当遇到OD物体时,分块网络的性能经常出现大幅度下降,可能对以前未见的内容作出高度自信而不正确的预测(见图1)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Top: Semantic segmentation by a deep neural network. Bottom: Evidential uncertainty heatmap obtained by our method. Brighter colors correspond to higher uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 图1:上部:由深神经网络分解出语义. 底部:通过我们的方法获得的实验性不确定性热图. 更亮的颜色对应更高的不确定性.

blocks.en: In safety-critical applications, such behavior can have severe consequences, as unknown objects may be misclassified as semantically meaningful classes and consequently result in dangerous downstream decisions.
blocks.zh: 在安全关键应用中,这种行为可能产生严重后果,因为未知物体可能被错误地归类为具有实质意义的类别,从而导致下游作出危险的决定.

blocks.en:
The task of OOD segmentation therefore extends beyond accurate segmentation of known categories and additionally requires reliable identification of regions that do not belong to the learned training distribution.
A central challenge in this context is the estimation of epistemic uncertainty, which arises from insufficient knowledge of the model rather than from noise inherent to the input data (i.e., aleatoric uncertainty).
Ideally, segmentation models should express increased uncertainty whenever unfamiliar or ambiguous observations are encountered. However, uncertainty measures derived from softmax outputs, such as maximum softmax probability [ 22 ] or predictive entropy, are known to be poorly calibrated and often remain overconfident for OOD samples [ 21 ] . Bayesian approaches [ 35 ] , including Monte Carlo Dropout [ 37 ] and Deep Ensembles [ 26 ] , address this limitation by approximating posterior distributions over model parameters and thereby providing a principled framework for uncertainty estimation.
Although these methods often improve uncertainty calibration, their reliance on multiple stochastic forward passes introduces substantial computational overhead, which can be prohibitive for dense prediction tasks on high-resolution images.
blocks.zh:
因此,将OD分解的任务超越了对已知类别进行精确分解,还需要可靠地确定不属于所学培训分布的区域。
在这方面的一个中心挑战是对感官不确定性的估计,这种不确定性来自对模型了解不足,而不是输入数据所固有的噪音(即厌食性不确定性)。
理想的情况是,在遇到不熟悉或模棱两可的观察时,分解模型应显示更大的不确定性。 然而,从软最大输出产生的不确定性度量,如最大软最大概率[22]或预测的等,已知校正不准确,对于OOD样本往往保持过度自信[21]. Bayesian方法[35],包括Monte Carlo Dropout [37]和Deep Ensembles [26],通过对模型参数的后期分布进行近似化,从而为不确定性估计提供原则框架来解决这一限制.
虽然这些方法往往能改善不确定性的校正,但是它们依赖多条有花样的向前行传,带来了大量的计算间接费用,这对于高分辨率图像的密集预测任务来说可能令人望而却步.

blocks.en:
Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) [ 44 ] has emerged as a computationally efficient alternative for uncertainty-aware prediction.
Rather than producing point estimates of class probabilities, EDL models the output as the parameters of a Dirichlet distribution and learns class-specific evidence values.
The amount of accumulated evidence directly reflects the confidence of the model, while a lack of evidence naturally translates into increased uncertainty. Consequently, EDL enables uncertainty estimation from a single deterministic forward pass and provides an attractive compromise between predictive performance and computational efficiency. Furthermore, the explicit representation of uncertainty makes EDL particularly suitable for OOD detection scenarios, where insufficient evidence should indicate unfamiliar observations.
blocks.zh:
深层学习(EDL)[44] 已作为一种计算效率高的可选择的不确定性-认知预测方法出现.
EDL不制作类概率的点估计,而是将输出作为Dirichlet分布的参数来进行模型化,并学习类特有证据值.
所积累的证据的数量直接反映了模型的信心,而缺乏证据自然会转化为更大的不确定性. 因此,EDL能够通过单一的确定性前行通道进行不确定性估计,并在预测性能和计算效率之间提供有吸引力的妥协。 此外,对不确定性的明确表述使得EDL特别适合OD检测情景,其中证据不足应表明不熟悉的观察。

blocks.en:
Most existing EDL approaches rely on Euclidean objectives, such as expected mean squared error (MSE), for optimizing the evidential distribution.
While these objectives are analytically convenient, they do not explicitly account for the geometry of probability distributions and may encourage overconfident predictions.
Recent work has therefore explored Wasserstein-based objectives as an alternative optimization criterion [ 7 ] . In contrast to conventional point-wise losses, Wasserstein distances measure discrepancies directly in the space of probability distributions and respect the underlying geometry of the probability simplex.
This property has been shown to improve distributional alignment and may lead to better calibrated uncertainty estimates, particularly in the presence of distributional shifts [ 7 ] . The benefits of Wasserstein-based losses for uncertainty modeling have also been investigated in [ 53 ] .
blocks.zh:
大多数现有的EDL方法都依赖于欧几利得目标,如预期平均平方差错(MSE)来优化证据分布.
虽然这些目标在分析上是方便的,但它们没有明确说明概率分布的几何特征,可能鼓励过度自信的预测.
因此,最近的工作探索了基于瓦瑟斯坦的目标,将其作为备选优化标准[7]。 与常规分点损失形成对比的是,瓦瑟斯坦距离直接测量概率分布空间的差异并尊重概率简单x的基本几何.
事实证明,这种属性可改善分配的对接,并可能导致更精确的不确定性估计,特别是在存在分配转移的情况下[7]。 在[53]中也调查了基于Wasserstein的损失对不确定性模型的效益。

blocks.en:
This work investigates the influence of the Wasserstein order on uncertainty-aware semantic segmentation and OOD segmentation.
While first-order Wasserstein distances penalize discrepancies linearly, higher-order variants increasingly emphasize larger deviations between distributions. Consequently, different Wasserstein orders may induce different optimization dynamics and affect the balance between segmentation performance on in-distribution samples and uncertainty estimation for OOD observations.
This motivates a systematic investigation of first-, second-, and third-order Wasserstein objectives ( W 1 W_{1} , W 2 W_{2} , and W 3 W_{3} ) [ 40 , 47 ] within a unified evidential learning framework. Due to different specific numerical limitations of expected values we add different regularization parameters.
We add a MSE and Dice Loss term as well as KL-regularization.
blocks.zh:
这部作品调查了瓦瑟斯坦命令对不确定性意识语义分解和OOD分化的影响.
虽然一阶Wasserstein距离对差异进行线性惩罚,但高阶变体越来越强调分布之间的较大偏差. 因此,不同的Wasserstein定单可能诱发不同的优化动态,并会影响分配样本上的分化性能与OD观测的不确定性估计之间的平衡。
这促使在统一的证据学习框架内,对第一、第二和第三顺序的Wasserstein目标(W 1 W_{1}、W 2 W_{2}和W 3 W_{3})[40,47]进行系统调查。 由于预期值的具体数字限制不同,我们增加了不同的正规化参数。
我们增加了MSE和Dice Loss以及KL正规化。

blocks.en:
In addition, uncertainty estimation is closely linked to the quality of the learned feature representation.
It therefore remains unclear whether the behavior of Wasserstein-based evidential learning is independent of the underlying network architecture or whether it interacts with specific representation-learning mechanisms.
To address this question, we evaluate the proposed approach on two fundamentally different segmentation architectures: DeepLabV3+, representing convolutional neural networks, and SegFormer, representing transformer-based architectures.
While DeepLabV3+ primarily exploits local spatial correlations through hierarchical convolutional feature extraction, SegFormer leverages self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range contextual dependencies.
Comparing both architectures provides insights into the relationship between feature representation, uncertainty estimation, and OOD robustness.
The code is publicly available on https://github.com/A-Brosch/EDL-OOD-Segmentation .
blocks.zh:
此外,不确定性估计与所学特征表述的质量密切相关。
因此,基于Wasserstein的证据学习的行为是否独立于基本的网络架构,或是否与具体的代表-学习机制相互作用,仍然不清楚。
为了解决这一问题,我们评价两个根本不同的分块结构的拟议方法:代表革命神经网络的DeepLabV3+和代表变压器结构的SegFormer.
虽然DeepLabV3+主要通过分级演化特征取出来利用本地空间的关联性,而SegFormer则利用了自觉机制来捕捉长距离上下文依赖性.
比较这两个结构可以深入了解特征表述、不确定性估计和OD稳健性之间的关系。
该代码在https://github.com/A-Brosch/EDL-OOD-Section上公开.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We investigate Wasserstein-based EDL for uncertainty-aware semantic segmentation in the context of OOD detection. • We provide a systematic comparison of different Wasserstein orders ( W 1 W_{1} , W 2 W_{2} , and W 3 W_{3} ) and analyze their influence on segmentation performance, uncertainty calibration, and OOD segmentation capability. • We study the interaction between Wasserstein-based evidential learning and network architecture by evaluating both a convolutional backbone (DeepLabV3+) and a transformer-based backbone (SegFormer). • We conduct extensive experiments on established OOD segmentation benchmarks, including LostAndFound, RoadObstacle21, RoadAnomaly21, and Fishyscapes, and provide an empirical analysis of the resulting trade-offs between in-distribution accuracy and OOD awareness.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们调查基于Wasserstein的EDL在OD检测背景下的不确定性意识语义分解。 我们系统比较了不同的瓦瑟斯坦订单(W 1 W_{1},W 2 W_{2}和W 3 W_{3}),并分析了它们对于分解性能,不确定性校正,和OOD分解能力的影响. ^ 我们研究基于Wasserstein的证据学习和网络架构之间的相互作用,通过评价一个革命骨干(DeepLabV3+)和一个基于变压器的骨干(SegFormer). 二. 支助 我们对既定的OOD分化基准进行了广泛的试验,包括LostAndFound、RoadObstacle21、RoadAnomaly21和Fishyscapes,并对分配中准确性和OOD意识之间的取舍进行了实证分析。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing approaches for OOD segmentation can be broadly grouped into four categories: uncertainty-based methods, feature-space methods, approaches leveraging auxiliary models, and methods that incorporate additional OOD data during training.
blocks.zh: 现有的OD分化方法可以大致分为四类:基于不确定性的方法、特征-空间方法、利用辅助模型的方法,以及在培训期间纳入其他OD数据的方法。

blocks.en:
One line of research uses additional real OOD data during training to explicitly expose the segmentation model to samples outside the closed set of in-distribution classes [ 5 , 15 ] . An early approach introduces an explicit void or anomaly class for supervision [ 4 ] , while other works combine outlier exposure with dedicated loss functions and/or specialized network architectures.
Examples include entropy maximization on OOD objects [ 9 ] , energy-based abstention learning [ 46 ] , hybrid discriminative-generative models [ 17 ] , and contrastive objectives that learn more robust anomaly representations [ 32 ] .
The paradigm is also extended to transformer-based mask-classification architectures, such as Mask2Anomaly [ 42 ] and EAM [ 18 ] .
Recent methods increasingly leverage foundation models and vision-language models to obtain more robust representations for OOD segmentation [ 23 , 36 , 38 , 55 ] .
blocks.zh:
一行研究在培训期间使用了额外的真实的OOD数据,明确将分解模型暴露在封闭的一组分解分解班外的样本上[5,15]. 早期的做法引入了明确的监督空白或异常类别[4],而其他工程则将外部接触与专用损失功能和/或专用网络架构相结合。
例子包括:OO物体上 en的最大化 [9],以能为基础的弃权学习 [46],混合式的歧义-再生模型 [17],以及学习更强反常表现的对比目标 [32].
范式还被扩展至以变压器为主的口罩分级架构,如Mask2 Anomaly [42]和EM [18].
最近的方法越来越多地利用基础模型和愿景语言模型,为OD分化获得更强有力的表述[23、36、38、55]。

blocks.en:
To reduce the dependence on real OOD samples, several methods instead generate synthetic negative data during training. For example, normalizing flows have been employed to synthesize outlier samples that serve as auxiliary supervision for OOD segmentation [ 6 , 16 , 19 , 27 ] .
Moreover, RbA [ 39 ] generates synthetic negatives and uses them to suppress the energy of OOD pixels, thereby improving the separation between in-distribution and OOD regions.
UNO [ 12 ] combines negative-objectness scores obtained from synthetic outliers with uncertainty estimates to derive a more robust OOD score.
blocks.zh:
为了减少对真实的OOD样本的依赖,有几种方法在训练期间生成合成负数据. 例如,利用了使流动正常化的方法来合成用于辅助监督OD分化的外部样品[6、16、19、27]。
此外,RbA [39]产生合成负数,并用它们来抑制OOD像素的能量,从而改善分化与OOD区域的分化.
UNO [12] 将从合成异常点得到的负-对象分数与不确定性估计数相结合,得出更强的OOD分数.

blocks.en:
The underlying assumption of a further group of methods is that regions from outside the training distribution are difficult to reconstruct or resynthesize faithfully.
Besnier et al. [ 3 ] operationalize this assumption by training a separate observer network that predicts, from adversarially perturbed features, where the primary segmentation network is likely to fail.
A closely related strategy resynthesizes the input image from its predicted segmentation and flags pixels where the resynthesis diverges strongly from the original [ 31 ] ; variants of this idea restrict the comparison to locally inpainted patches [ 30 ] , couple reconstruction and segmentation within a single joint model [ 49 ] , or assess the reconstructability of individual image patches directly [ 48 ] .
Beyond image-level reconstruction, structure-constrained learning distills structural knowledge from a teacher network into a student model, improving segmentation of unseen classes across OOD, zero-shot, and domain-adaptation settings [ 54 ] .
blocks.zh:
另一组方法的基本假设是,培训分配以外的区域很难忠实地重建或再合成。
贝斯尼尔等. [3] 将这一假设付诸实施,培训一个单独的观察网络,从对抗性扰动特征中预测初级分解网络可能失败。
一个紧密相通的策略从它预测的分块和旗帜像素中重新合成输入图像,其中再合成与原 [31] 有很大的相异;这个想法的变体限制了与局部被涂抹的补丁的比较 [30],单联合模型中的夫妇重建与分块 [49],或者直接评估单个图像补丁的可重建性 [48].
除了图像层面的重建外,结构受限的学习将结构知识从教师网络中提炼成学生模式,改善整个OOD、零镜头和域-适应设置的未见课堂的分化[54]。

blocks.en:
Rather than relying on the network’s predictive confidence, a third group of methods judges an input by where it falls within the learned feature space.
cDNP [ 14 ] and PixOOD [ 50 ] estimate the in-distribution feature distribution non-parametrically or through class-conditional density models, treating pixels whose features fall outside the estimated support as anomalous.
A related but distinct strategy fits an explicit density model with a normalizing flow: [ 6 ] trains such a flow directly on the feature embeddings and scores pixels by their negative log-likelihood, and FlowEneDet [ 19 ] applies the same principle to the energy scores of an already frozen, pretrained segmentation model. [ 45 ] takes a complementary route, modeling each known class as a Gaussian while jointly learning a binary anomaly decoder that exploits similarity between classes, whereas Maskomaly [ 1 ] requires no additional training at all, repurposing the mask embeddings of a pretrained panoptic network and flagging anomalies through irregularities in their class-agnostic properties.
blocks.zh:
第三组方法不是依靠网络的预测性信心,而是根据它属于所学的特征空间的范围来判断一种投入。
cDNP [14]和PixOOD [50] 以非参数或通过类条件密度模型来估计分泌特征分布,将特征不属于估计支持范围的像素视为异常.
一个相关但截然不同的策略符合具有常态化流量的清晰密度模型: [6] 直接将这种流量在特征上嵌入和分数像素上,通过负的对数相似,而FlowEneDet [19] 对已经被冷冻,预受训练分化模型的能量分数适用了同样的原则. [45]采取互补路线,将每个已知的班级建模为高斯人,同时共同学习利用班级相近性的二进制异常解码器,而马斯科马利[1]则不需要额外的训练,重新使用预先被训练的泛光学网络所嵌入的口罩,并因其班级不可知性中的不合规定之处来标出异常.

blocks.en:
A fourth direction relies purely on the network’s own predictive behavior to flag OOD regions, without inspecting its internal features.
The simplest such scores are read directly off the softmax output, most notably the maximum softmax probability [ 22 ] and predictive entropy, both of which are cheap to compute but tend to stay overconfident on unfamiliar inputs [ 44 ] .
Sampling-based alternatives instead aggregate several stochastic forward passes, for instance via Monte Carlo Dropout [ 37 ] or Deep Ensembles [ 26 ] , trading substantially higher inference cost for improved calibration.
A cheaper route to a similarly informative signal exploits the gradients of the loss landscape with respect to hypothesized labels, as in pixel-wise gradient norms (PGN, [ 34 ] ), while Mahalanobis [ 28 ] and ODIN [ 29 ] instead perturb the input itself to sharpen the separation between in- and out-of-distribution confidence scores.
Most closely related to our own work, Evidential Deep Learning [ 44 ] departs from all of these by reformulating the output layer to directly parameterize a Dirichlet distribution over class probabilities, so that epistemic uncertainty can be read off from the accumulated evidence within a single deterministic forward pass [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh:
第四个方向完全依靠网络本身的预测行为来标出OD区域,而不检查其内部特征.

blocks.en:
In contrast to the approaches discussed above, our method requires neither auxiliary architectures, additional OOD training data, nor feature-space post-processing.
Our approach belongs to the class of uncertainty-based OOD segmentation methods, as it derives uncertainty directly and deterministically from the evidential output of the segmentation network itself.
Unlike sampling-based approaches such as MC Dropout or deep ensembles, our method requires only a single forward pass and does not rely on multiple stochastic predictions. Furthermore, in contrast to gradient-based or adversarial approaches, no additional backward passes or input perturbations are required. Therefore, our method is computationally closest to output-based uncertainty baselines such as maximum softmax probability.
blocks.zh:
与上述方法相反,我们的方法既不需要辅助架构,也不需要额外的OD训练数据,也不需要特性空间后处理。
我们的方法属于基于不确定性的OD分解方法类别,因为它直接和确定不确定性来自分解网络本身的证据输出。
与基于抽样的方法如MC Dropout或深聚体不同,我们的方法只要求一次前行通过,不依赖多条花样预测. 此外,与以梯度为基础的办法或对抗办法不同,不需要额外的后向通行证或输入扰动。 因此,我们的方法在计算上最接近基于输出的不确定性基线,如最大软马克斯概率.

blocks.en:
Our own preliminary study established the general feasibility of Wasserstein-based evidential learning using a fixed first-order objective on a single convolutional architecture [ 7 ] , and the present work extends this line of research along two axes.
First, we systematically vary the order of the Wasserstein objective ( W 1 W_{1} , W 2 W_{2} , W 3 W_{3} ) to study its effect on the trade-off between in-distribution accuracy and OOD awareness.
Second, we evaluate the resulting framework on both a convolutional architecture (DeepLabV3+) and a transformer-based architecture (SegFormer), which lets us disentangle properties of the objective from properties of the learned representation.
In addition, we broaden the evaluation from LostAndFound, RoadObstacle21 and RoadAnomaly21 to the complete SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark, including Fishyscapes.
blocks.zh:
我们自己的初步研究确定了基于瓦瑟斯坦的证据学学习的总体可行性,使用一个固定的一阶目标在一个单一的革命建筑上[7],目前的工作将这一研究线从两个轴线上延伸.
首先,我们系统地改变Wasserstein目标(W 1 W_{1},W 2 W_{2},W 3 W_{3})的顺序,以研究它对于分配精度与OD意识之间的权衡影响.
第二,我们评价由此产生的关于革命结构(DeepLabV3+)和以变压器为基础的结构(SegFormer)的框架,这使我们能够将目标属性与所学代表特性区分开来。
此外,我们把评价范围从LostAndFound、RoadObstacle21和RoadAnomaly21扩大到完整的部分MefYouCan基准,包括鱼景区。

blocks.en:
Our work builds on the mathematical theory of optimal transport, which studies the minimal cost of transforming one probability distribution into another with respect to a given ground metric [ 40 , 47 ] .
From a measure-theoretic perspective, the training procedure of a segmentation network implicitly defines a probability measure over the joint space of image features and semantic labels, whose support is fixed by the finite collection of training instances and the label distribution observed during learning, so that the categories realized by this measure constitute the effective domain over which the network can make confident predictions.
At deployment, however, the network is queried on inputs that may contain atoms outside this support, namely OOD objects that were never represented during training, so that the test distribution can be viewed as an extension of the training distribution by previously unseen atoms. This can be seen schematically in Fig. 2 .
Since any probability measure is normalized to unit total mass, accommodating these additional atoms is only possible by redistributing mass away from the atoms already present in the training support, and for an OOD input the network has no means of placing mass on the unseen atom directly, so this mismatch must instead be reflected in how the available mass is redistributed across the known atoms.
This observation motivates casting OOD-aware prediction as a mass-transportation problem, for which optimal transport theory provides the natural mathematical language, characterizing the minimal cost of transforming one probability measure into another with respect to a chosen ground metric on the underlying space.
Wasserstein distances instantiate this cost for probability distributions and thereby give a geometry-aware notion of discrepancy that, in contrast to divergences such as the KL divergence or cross-entropy, remains well-defined and informative even for distributions with disjoint or only partially overlapping support [ 47 , 40 ] , precisely the regime in which OOD detection operates.
This property has made Wasserstein distances attractive well beyond their origin in transportation theory.
In deep learning, they have been popularized primarily through generative modeling, most notably the Wasserstein GAN [ 2 ] , which replaces the Jensen-Shannon objective of the original GAN formulation with a Wasserstein critic to stabilize adversarial training, and through efficient approximate solvers such as entropic (Sinkhorn) regularization [ 40 ] , which make optimal transport tractable at the scale required by deep networks.
Closer to our setting, Wasserstein-based losses have also been proposed directly for supervised learning with structured or multi-label outputs [ 13 ] , exploiting a predefined ground metric between classes to obtain gradients that respect semantic similarity rather than treating all misclassifications as equally costly. It has been shown further to behave beneficial regarding the modeling of uncertainty shown in [ 53 ] .
Our work differs from these applications in that we do not use the Wasserstein distance to compare a generator distribution to real data or to encode class-level semantic similarity, but instead employ it, within the evidential framework, as a geometry-aware alternative to the Euclidean (MSE) objective for training the parameters of a Dirichlet distribution, following the formulation recently proposed for evidential segmentation in our preliminary study [ 7 ] , and directly motivated by the support-extension view of OOD detection developed above.

我们的工作以最佳运输的数学理论为基础,该理论研究了将一个概率分布转化为另一个概率分布对某一地标[40,47]的最低成本。
从计量-理论的角度来看,分解网络的培训程序隐含地定义了在图像特征和语义标签的联合空间上的概率度量,其支持由有限的培训实例集和在学习过程中所观察到的标签分布来固定,这样,这一措施所实现的类别就构成了网络能够做出自信预测的有效域.
然而,在部署时,网络被问及可能含有这种支持以外的原子的投入,即训练期间从未代表的OOD物体,这样就可以将试验分布视为训练分布被先前看不见的原子所延伸。 这一点在图2中可以看出来。
由于任何概率度量均会正常化为单位总质量,所以容纳这些额外的原子只能通过将质量从训练支持中已经存在的原子中再分配出来,而对于OD输入,网络没有办法将质量直接放入看不见的原子上,因此这种不匹配必须反映在现有质量如何在已知原子中再分配上.
这种观察促使人们将OOD-感知预测作为一种质量运输问题,而最佳运输理论提供了自然的数学语言,它说明了将一个概率计量转换成另一个概率计量的最小成本与在基础空间上选定的地面测量值。
Wasserstein距离将概率分布的这一成本即时化,从而给出一种几何认识的差异概念,即与KL相差或交叉交替等差异形成对比,即使分布支持脱节或仅部分相重叠[47,40],精确地说,OD检测运行的制度也仍然定义明确,信息丰富.
这种地产使得瓦瑟斯坦的距离在运输理论中具有远超其起源的吸引力.
在深度学习中,它们主要通过基因模型来被普及,最出名的是"瓦瑟斯坦"(Wasserstein GAN [2]),它用"瓦瑟斯坦"(Wasserstein)评论家来取而代之的原GAN配方的Jensen-Shannon目标来稳定对抗性训练,并通过"活体"(Sinkhorn)正规化[40]等高效的近似解器,使最优的运输可达到深层网络所要求的规模.
更接近于我们的设定,基于Wasserstein的损失也直接被提议用于有条理或多标签产出的有监督的学习[13],利用各类之间预先界定的地标来获得尊重语义相似性的梯度,而不是将所有错误的分类视为同等成本。 事实进一步表明,在[53] 所示的不确定性模型模型方面,它的表现是有益的。
我们的工作与这些应用不同,因为我们不使用Wasserstein距离将生成器分布与真实数据进行比较或编码类语义相似性,而是在证据框架内,按照我们初步研究中最近提出的证据分解的提法,利用它作为欧克利德语(MSE)目标培训Dirichlet分布参数的几何认识替代物,直接取自上文开发的OD检测支持-扩展观点。

blocks.en:
EDL provides an alternative to both conventional softmax-based confidence estimation and computationally expensive Bayesian inference.
Instead of interpreting network outputs as a single categorical probability vector, EDL models a higher-order distribution over class probabilities [ 24 , 44 ] . This allows the network to jointly represent class beliefs and epistemic uncertainty within a single deterministic forward pass.
Consequently, EDL is particularly attractive for dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation, where Bayesian sampling approaches often become computationally expensive.

因此,EDL对于语义分解等密集的预测任务特别有吸引力,因为贝叶斯取样方法往往在计算上变得昂贵.

The Wasserstein distance measures the minimal transport effort required to transform one probability distribution into another and therefore provides a geometry-aware notion of similarity.
In contrast to Euclidean objectives, Wasserstein distances preserve information about the relative arrangement of probability mass and allow uncertainty to remain distributed across multiple classes when the available evidence is inconclusive.

Wasserstein距离测量将一个概率分布转换成另一个概率分布所需的最小迁移努力,因此提供了几何认识相似性的概念.
与欧几利得目标相反,瓦瑟斯坦距离保存了概率质量相对安排的信息,并允许不确定性在现有证据无定论时在多类之间分布.

Consequently, all probability mass assigned to incorrect atoms is penalized equally, encouraging uncertainty rather than overconfident misclassification. Geometrically, this results in smoother transitions within the probability simplex and avoids the aggressive evidence concentration typically induced by MSE-based objectives (see Fig. 4 ).

A central contribution of this work is the investigation of the influence of the Wasserstein order on uncertainty-aware semantic segmentation.
Previous Wasserstein-based EDL approaches [ 7 ] predominantly employ first-order Wasserstein distances and do not analyze the effect of alternative orders. The general q q -Wasserstein distance is defined as, W q ​ ( μ , ν ) = ( inf γ ∈ Γ ⁡ ( μ , ν ) ∫ d ​ ( x , y ) q ​ 𝑑 γ ​ ( x , y ) ) 1 / q , W_{q}(\mu,\nu)=\left(\inf_{\gamma\in\Gamma(\mu,\nu)}\int d(x,y)^{q}\,d\gamma(x,y)\right)^{1/q}\kern 5.0pt, (6) where Γ ⁡ ( μ , ν ) \Gamma(\mu,\nu) denotes the set of admissible transport plans and d ⁡ ( x , y ) d(x,y) is the transport cost between two locations [ 40 , 47 ] .
The Wasserstein order determines the relative influence of large and small transport costs on the optimization objective.
For transport costs normalized to the interval [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , increasing the order progressively suppresses the contribution of small discrepancies while relatively amplifying larger mismatches. Consequently, higher-order Wasserstein objectives focus increasingly on substantial distributional deviations.

blocks.en:
In the context of OOD segmentation, this property may have important implications. OOD samples frequently induce predictive distributions that differ substantially from those observed for in-distribution data.
By assigning greater importance to such large discrepancies, higher-order Wasserstein objectives may improve the separation between in-distribution and OOD observations.
Conversely, emphasizing large deviations too strongly may reduce sensitivity to subtle class-specific distinctions required for accurate semantic segmentation.
This suggests the existence of an order-dependent trade-off between segmentation accuracy and uncertainty awareness.
blocks.zh:
在OD分割方面,这种财产可能具有重要影响。 食物样本经常诱发预测性分布,这种分布与所观察到的传播数据大相径庭。
通过更加重视这种巨大的差异,更高级的Wasserstein目标可以改善分配观测和OO观测之间的分离。
反之,强调大的偏差过于强烈,可能会降低对精确语义分化所需的细微分类区分的敏感性.
这表明分化准确性和不确定性意识之间存在依赖订单的取舍.

blocks.en:
From a geometric viewpoint, lower-order Wasserstein objectives preserve local structure within the probability simplex and therefore maintain sensitivity to subtle class-specific variations. Higher-order objectives, on the other hand, increasingly prioritize global distributional discrepancies.
Determining how these competing effects influence uncertainty estimation and OOD detection constitutes one of the central research questions of this work.
blocks.zh:
从几何学角度看,下级的瓦瑟斯坦目标将局部结构保存在概率简单的x以内,因此保持了对细微的类特异性的敏感性. 另一方面,更高排序的目标越来越优先考虑全球分配差异。
确定这些相互竞争的影响如何影响不确定性估计和OD检测是这项工作的中心研究问题之一。

(7) Unlike pixel-wise objectives, the Dice loss operates on complete segmentation regions and therefore encourages coherent object shapes and improved overlap between predicted and ground-truth masks.

blocks.en:
To further reduce overconfident predictions, particularly in ambiguous regions and OOD inputs, we employ a Kullback-Leibler regularization term ℒ KL = KL [ Dir ( α ) ∥ Dir ( 1 ) ] , \mathcal{L}_{\text{KL}}=\mathrm{KL}\left[\mathrm{Dir}(\alpha)\,\|\,\mathrm{Dir}(1)\right]\kern 5.0pt, (8) with Dir referring to the Dirichlet distribution.
This regularization encourages the predicted Dirichlet distribution to remain close to a non-informative uniform prior whenever insufficient evidence is available. In the evidential setting, this mechanism discourages unsupported evidence accumulation and prevents the model from assigning excessive confidence to observations for which little evidence exists.
As a result, uncertain predictions are encouraged to collapse towards a vacuous prior distribution rather than towards arbitrary semantic classes, which is particularly beneficial in the presence of OOD objects.
To avoid interfering with representation learning during the early training stages, the KL contribution is introduced gradually through an annealing schedule.

blocks.en:
Although the proposed loss formulation is independent of the underlying segmentation architecture, the resulting uncertainty estimates may depend on the learned feature representations.
We therefore evaluate the proposed framework on convolutional as well as on transformer-based architectures.
This comparison allows us to assess whether the behavior induced by different Wasserstein orders generalizes across fundamentally different representation-learning paradigms.

虽然拟议的损失提法独立于基本的分块结构,但由此产生的不确定性估计可能取决于所学到的特征说明。
因此,我们评价关于革命和以变压器为基础的结构的拟议框架。
这种比较使我们能够评估不同瓦瑟斯坦引起的行为是否要求概括到根本不同的代表-学习范式。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setting

blocks.en:
Datasets. For training, we employ the Cityscapes dataset [ 11 ] , one of the standard benchmarks for semantic segmentation in urban street scenes. Cityscapes consists of 2,975 2,975 finely annotated training and 500 500 validation images, captured in 50 50 different European cities under varying weather and illumination conditions.
The dataset provides high-resolution images ( 1,024 × 2,048 1,\!024\times 2,\!048 pixels) with pixel-wise annotations for 19 19 semantic classes, including roads, sidewalks, buildings, vehicles, pedestrians, and traffic infrastructure. Owing to its diversity and annotation quality, Cityscapes has become the de facto standard training dataset for semantic segmentation in autonomous driving and serves as the in-distribution (ID) data throughout this work.
blocks.zh:
数据集. 在培训方面,我们采用了Cityscapes数据集[11],这是城市街道场景中语义分化的标准基准之一. 城市景观包括2,975,2,975个有精细注释的训练以及500个验证图像,在50个不同的欧洲城市在不同的天气和发光条件下被捕获.
该数据集提供高分辨率图像(1,024 × 2,048 1,\!024\times 2,\!048像素),并附有19个语义类的像素-顺理成章的说明,包括道路,人行道,建筑物,车辆,行人,以及交通基础设施等. 由于其多样性和注释质量,Cityscapes已成为自主驾驶中语义分解事实上的标准培训数据集,并在整个工作过程中充当分解(ID)数据.

blocks.en:
For evaluating OOD segmentation, we follow the official SegmentMeIfYouCan (SMIYC) benchmark [ 8 ] , which comprises four complementary datasets covering different OOD scenarios.
The LostAndFound (LAF) dataset [ 41 ] contains 1,203 1,\!203 real-world images recorded in urban driving environments with numerous small road obstacles, such as boxes, stones, tires, or plastic objects, deliberately placed on the roadway.
blocks.zh:
在评估OD分解时,我们遵循正式的Side MeifYouCan(SMIYC)基准[8],该基准包括涵盖不同OD情景的四个互补数据集.
LostAndFound(LAF)数据集[41]包含有1,203 1\!203真实世界的图像,记录在城市行驶环境中,有许多小路障碍物,如盒子,石头,轮胎,或塑料物体等,被故意放入道上.

blocks.en:
RoadObstacle21 [ 8 ] extends this setting by providing 412 412 images with substantially greater diversity in both obstacle categories and environmental conditions.
In contrast to LostAndFound, the dataset contains a wider range of everyday objects and naturally occurring road hazards, including construction material, debris, furniture, and other unexpected obstacles, thereby improving the evaluation of real-world robustness.
blocks.zh:
RoadObstacle21 [8] 扩展了这一设置,提供了412 412个图像,在障碍类别和环境条件方面都具有显著更大的多样性。
与LostAndFound相反,该数据集包含更广泛的日常物品和自然发生的道路危险,包括建筑材料,碎片,家具等出乎意料的障碍,从而改进了对现实世界稳健性的评价.

blocks.en: The Fishyscapes LostAndFound dataset [ 6 ] comprises 100 100 validation images and 275 275 non-public test images, with refined pixel-wise annotations distinguishing between OOD objects, in-distribution background corresponding to Cityscapes classes, and void regions containing all other pixels.
blocks.zh: Fishyscapes LostAndFound数据集 [6] 由100个100个验证图像和275个非公用测试图像组成,其中精细的像素类说明区分了OD对象,与Cityscapes类相对应的分散背景,以及包含所有其他像素的空白区域.

blocks.en:
RoadAnomaly21 [ 8 ] contains 100 100 carefully curated images depicting highly diverse anomalous situations that are largely absent from conventional training datasets.
Rather than focusing solely on road obstacles, it includes unusual objects, animals, uncommon vehicles, and rare scene configurations, making it particularly suitable for evaluating the generalization capability of uncertainty-aware segmentation methods under severe distributional shifts.
blocks.zh:
Road Anomaly21 [8] 包含100个精心整理的图像,描绘了传统训练数据集中基本上没有的高度多样化的异常情况.
它不只侧重于道路障碍,而是包括不寻常的物体、动物、不寻常的车辆和罕见的场景配置,使它特别适合评估在严重分流转移情况下的不确定性-意识分化方法的一般化能力。

blocks.en:
We evaluate the proposed loss formulation on both DeepLabV3+ [ 10 ] with a ResNet-50 backbone and SegFormer [ 52 ] .
DeepLabV3+ serves as a representative convolutional semantic segmentation architecture, which is commonly used in OOD segmentation literature [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] , while SegFormer represents a transformer-based approach with a hierarchical encoder and lightweight decoder.
Comparing both architectures allows us to assess whether the proposed Wasserstein-based evidential learning generalizes consistently across different segmentation paradigms.

We run ablations on the weighting parameters λ \lambda of our combined loss function, see ( 9 ). The KL regularization weight is increased linearly from 0 0 to λ KL \lambda_{\text{KL}} between iterations 40 40 K and 48 48 K and then kept constant for the remainder of training.
This annealing strategy allows the model to first learn discriminative semantic features while the learning rate is still relatively high and subsequently shifts the optimization focus towards uncertainty calibration and regularization. Without this scheduling, KL regularization tends to suppress evidence generation too early during training, resulting in reduced segmentation performance.

blocks.en:
When transferring the proposed loss formulation from DeepLabV3+ to SegFormer, we observed a fundamental difference in the logit distributions.
While DeepLabV3+ produces logits in the range of approximately − 550 -550 to 1500 1500 , SegFormer logits are much more compressed, typically ranging from − 30 -30 to 5 5 .
As a consequence, around 12% of all pixels exhibit only negative logits.
Since evidential deep learning derives the evidence values through a ReLU activation, these pixels receive zero evidence despite the model producing a valid segmentation prediction.
This highlights the sensitivity of evidential learning to architecture-dependent logit calibration, an effect that has also been discussed for semantic segmentation models in [ 51 ] .
To mitigate this issue, we replace the ReLU activation with Softplus when evaluating SegFormer logits, ensuring that all predictions contribute non-zero evidence while preserving the ordering of the logits.

blocks.en:
To evaluate the OOD segmentation performance, we follow the official benchmark protocol and report both pixel-level and segment-level metrics.
On the pixel-level, we use the area under the precision-recall curve (AuPRC) and the false positive rate at 95 % 95\% true positive rate (FPR 95 ).
AuPRC measures the overall separability between OOD and in-distribution pixels across all thresholds, whereas FPR 95 quantifies the number of incorrectly detected OOD pixels when maintaining a high true positive detection rate.
The latter is particularly relevant in safety-critical applications, where excessive false alarms may negatively affect downstream decision systems.
blocks.zh:
为了评价OD分解性能,我们遵循官方的基准协议,并报告像素级和分解级的度量衡.

blocks.en:
On the segment-level, we report the averaged adjusted similarity-weighted intersection-over-union (sIoU), positive predictive value (PPV), and F 1 F_{1} score following the SegmentMeIfYouCan protocol. These metrics evaluate not only whether anomalous pixels are detected, but also whether complete anomalous objects are localized accurately.
All segment-level measures are averaged across thresholds ranging from 0.25 0.25 to 0.75 0.75 with a step size of 0.05 0.05 .

所有分级计量均从0.25-0.25到0.75-0.75不等,分级尺寸为0.05-0.05。

blocks.en:
Furthermore, standard semantic segmentation performance is assessed using mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) on Cityscapes.
Reporting both mIoU and OOD metrics allows us to analyze the trade-off between in-distribution segmentation performance and uncertainty-aware OOD detection, which constitutes one of the primary objectives of this work.

此外,对标准语义分解性能的评估使用城市景观上平均跨分解-联盟(mIoU).
报告mIoU和OOD的度量,使我们能够分析分配分解性能与不确定性意识OOD检测之间的取舍,这是这项工作的主要目标之一。

blocks.en: 4.2 Numerical Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 数值结果

blocks.en:
We conduct a series of experiments to systematically evaluate the proposed loss method.
We first investigate different weightings of the individual loss components and analyze the influence of different Wasserstein orders ( W 1 W_{1} , W 2 W_{2} , and W 3 W_{3} ).
Subsequently, we evaluate the proposed formulation across different segmentation architectures to assess its general applicability.
The results are given in
Tables A.1 – A.12 ,
and some qualitative examples are shown in Fig. 5 .
Finally, we compare the resulting models against established OOD segmentation baselines to quantify their performance in OOD segmentation.

我们首先调查单个损失成分的不同加权,并分析不同的瓦瑟斯坦订单(W 1 W_{1},W 2 W_{2}和W 3 W_{3})的影响.
随后,我们评价了在不同分区结构中的拟议表述,以评估其普遍适用性。

blocks.en:
We first analyze the individual loss components.
Comparing pure MSE training ( λ MSE = 1 \lambda_{\text{MSE}}=1 ) against pure Wasserstein training ( λ 𝒲 = 1 \lambda_{\mathcal{W}}=1 ), pure Wasserstein training generally provides stronger OOD performance than pure MSE training.
Although this advantage is not consistent across all datasets and architectures, for example, in Fishyscapes LostAndFound, the MSE loss is often stronger than Wasserstein, whereas in the other three datasets, the opposite is observed.
Both objectives generally perform considerably worse when optimized individually compared to their combination in the proposed Wasserstein MSE formulation, indicating that the two objectives complement each other.
Using the DeepLabV3+ with W 1 W_{1} configuration as a representative example (see Table A.1 ), adding this residual MSE contribution stabilizes training further.
A weight of λ MSE = 0.45 \lambda_{\text{MSE}}=0.45 gives the best overall trade off on LostAndFound and RoadObstacle21, improving AuPRC on LAF to 53.2 53.2 over both the pure Wasserstein setting ( 47.5 47.5 ) and the pure MSE variant ( 25.7 25.7 ). We adopt this value as the reference for the remaining ablations in this configuration.
Across the other Wasserstein orders and both architectures, an MSE weight between 0.40 0.40 and 0.50 0.50 remains consistently among the strongest choices, so this component generalizes well.

blocks.en:
Introducing the Dice term markedly improves FPR 95 for W 1 W_{1} , reducing it from 23.2 23.2 at λ Dice = 0 \lambda_{\text{Dice}}=0 to 17.6 17.6 on LostAndFound at λ Dice = 0.75 \lambda_{\text{Dice}}=0.75 , while simultaneously raising sIoU ¯ \overline{\text{sIoU}} and F 1 ¯ \overline{F_{1}} .
Stronger Dice weighting ( λ Dice = 0.80 \lambda_{\text{Dice}}=0.80 ) reverses these gains and degrades performance across the board, confirming an optimal intermediate weighting for this order.
The Dice regularization effect is less consistent across orders. For DeepLabV3+ with W 2 W_{2} and W 3 W_{3} , increasing λ Dice \lambda_{\text{Dice}} does not reduce FPR 95 as clearly as for W 1 W_{1} , indicating that this particular benefit is order dependent rather than universal.

blocks.en:
Adding annealed KL regularization on top of the Wasserstein Dice MSE combination has a comparatively small and dataset dependent effect throughout our ablations.
Consistent with this small and inconsistent effect, the KL term is not required for the best trade off: for DeepLabV3+ with W 1 W_{1} order, the configuration λ 𝒲 = 1.0 \lambda_{\mathcal{W}}=1.0 , λ MSE = 0.45 \lambda_{\text{MSE}}=0.45 , λ Dice = 0.75 \lambda_{\text{Dice}}=0.75 , λ KL = 0.0 \lambda_{\text{KL}}=0.0 already provides the most robust compromise on LostAndFound (AuPRC 47.4 47.4 , FPR 95 17.6 17.6 , sIoU ¯ \overline{\text{sIoU}} 26.6 26.6 , PPV ¯ \overline{\text{PPV}} 41.1 41.1 , F 1 ¯ \overline{F_{1}} 24.2 24.2 ), matching or exceeding the KL-regularized variants on the segmentation-quality metrics while attaining the lowest FPR 95 of all W 1 W_{1} configurations.
The KL term therefore primarily serves to calibrate the in-distribution predictions, as discussed below, rather than to improve OOD detection.

blocks.en: Instead of a trade off that holds uniformly across all datasets, architectures, and metrics, we find that the preferred Wasserstein order depends primarily on the backbone and, to a lesser extent, on the dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,与其在所有数据集、架构和度量衡上统一进行交易,不如说,Wasserstein的首选顺序主要取决于主干,在较小的程度上取决于数据集。

blocks.en:
On DeepLabV3+, second-order objectives are favored on three of the four benchmarks. W 2 W_{2} achieves the strongest LostAndFound detection with 62.9 62.9 AuPRC when combined with a Dice weight of 0.75 0.75 , and it also achieves the best RoadObstacle21 scores. On RoadAnomaly21, W 2 W_{2} reaches 57.9 57.9 AuPRC, clearly ahead of the best W 3 W_{3} configuration at 43.7 43.7 AuPRC.
Only on Fishyscapes does W 3 W_{3} achieve a higher AuPRC than W 2 W_{2} , and only by a small margin ( 20.4 20.4 compared to 18.0 18.0 ).
In general, W 2 W_{2} is the preferred order on the convolutional backbone.
Third-order objectives on DeepLabV3+ are additionally penalized in terms of false-positive rate: FPR 95 remains above 80 % 80\% on both LostAndFound and RoadObstacle21 for the majority of W 3 W_{3} configurations, compared to 17.6 % 17.6\% for the best W 1 W_{1} or W 2 W_{2} setting.

关于DeepLabV3+的第三顺序目标在假阳性率方面受到额外惩罚:对于大多数W 3 W_{3}的配置来说,在LostAndFound和RoadObstacle21上,FPR 95仍然高于80%;而对于最好的W 1 W_{1}或W 2 W_{2}的配置来说,则高于17.6% 17.6%。

blocks.en:
On SegFormer, the balance shifts toward the third order. W 3 W_{3} attains the best AuPRC on all four benchmarks, reaching 47.9 47.9 on LostAndFound, 42.1 42.1 on RoadObstacle21, 38.2 38.2 on Fishyscapes, and 64.5 64.5 on RoadAnomaly21. On the obstacle datasets (i.e., LostAndFound and RoadObstacle21), this lead is pronounced ( W 3 W_{3} clearly ahead of both W 1 W_{1} and W 2 W_{2} ), whereas on the two more diverse anomaly datasets the advantage of W 3 W_{3} over the best W 2 W_{2} configuration is small ( 64.5 64.5 versus 59.6 59.6 on RoadAnomaly21, 38.2 38.2 versus 36.5 36.5 on Fishyscapes).
To summarize, rather than a single globally optimal order, our results point to an architecture-dependent optimum, i.e., W 2 W_{2} is the preferred order for the convolutional backbone, with one exception on Fishyscapes, while W 3 W_{3} is preferred for the transformer backbone, most clearly on the obstacle datasets.
blocks.zh:
在SegFormer上,平衡转向了第三顺序. W 3 W_{3}在所有四个基准上都取得了最好的AuPRC,在LostAndFound上达到47.9 47.9分,在Obstacle21路达到42.1 42.1分,在鱼景区达到38.2 38.2分,在Anomaly21路达到64.5 64.5分. 在障碍数据集(即LostAndFound和RoadObstacle21)上,这一线索的发音(W 3 W_{3}明显领先于W 1 W_{1}和W 2 W_{2}),而两个更加多样化的异常数据集上,W 3 W_{3}相对于最佳的W 2 W_{2}配置的优势很小(在Road Anomaly21,38.2 38.2对36.5 36.5对鱼景区).
简而言之,我们的结果并不是一个单一的全球最佳秩序,而是指出一个结构依赖的最佳秩序,即W2 W_{2}是革命骨干的优先秩序,但Fishyscapes例外,W3 W_{3}是变压器骨干的优先秩序,最明显的是障碍数据集。

blocks.en: Beyond the choice of objective, we studied the interaction between Wasserstein-based evidential learning and the underlying network architecture by evaluating both a convolutional backbone (DeepLabV3+ with ResNet-50) and a transformer-based backbone (SegFormer).
blocks.zh: 除了选择目标外,我们研究了基于Wasserstein的证据学习与基础网络架构之间的相互作用,既评价了革命骨干(DeepLabV3+与ResNet-50),又评价了基于变压器的骨干(SegFormer).

blocks.en:
The architecture comparison shows that the optimal configuration differs between backbones, particularly with respect to the Wasserstein order
DeepLabV3+ attains its best detection with W 2 W_{2} and comparatively strong Dice regularization, whereas SegFormer reaches its strongest results with W 3 W_{3} under light regularization.
On RoadAnomaly21 the best SegFormer configuration is a lean λ MSE = 0.40 \lambda_{\text{MSE}}=0.40 setup that reaches 64.5 64.5 AuPRC, the highest OOD detection score of the entire study.
This suggests that the globally aggregated features of the transformer interact differently with the emphasis on large distributional deviations, favoring higher-order objectives and requiring less residual MSE stabilization than the convolutional backbone.
This backbone-dependent optimum is also reflected in a dataset specialization: SegFormer leads on three of the four OOD benchmarks, namely RoadObstacle21, Fishyscapes, and RoadAnomaly21, whereas DeepLabV3+ retains a clear advantage on LostAndFound, whose small, well-delineated on-road objects appear well matched to the local receptive fields of the CNN.
blocks.zh:
架构比较显示,骨干间的最佳配置不同,特别是在瓦瑟施泰因秩序方面.
DeepLabV3+以W 2 W_{2}达到最佳检测,并相对强大 在轻度规范化下,
在Anomaly21公路上 最好的 SegFormer 配置是精益的 QQ MSE = 0.40\lambda_{\text{MSE}}=0.40 设置,达到 64.5 64.5 AuPRC,是整个研究中最高的OOD检测分.
这表明,变压器的全球综合特征与强调大分布偏差,偏好高序目标,要求残余的MSE稳定性要小于起伏骨干之间的相互作用不同.
这一依赖骨干网的优化还体现在数据集的专门化: SegFormer领先于四个OOD基准中的三个,即:RoadObstacle21、Fishyscapes和RoadAnomaly21,而DeepLabV3+则在LostAndFound上保留了明显的优势,其小型,精心划定的路上物体似乎与CNN的当地接受领域非常相配.

We compare our method against 7 uncertainty-based baselines, i.e., sampling-based (Ensemble, MC Dropout), output-based (Maximum Softmax, Entropy), and adversarial samples/gradient-based methods (PGN, ODIN, Mahalanobis).
The results for LostAndFound and RoadObstacle21 are given in Table 1 , and for Fishyscapes and RoadAnomaly21 in Table 2 .
For all datasets we report a single, fixed DeepLabV3+ configuration rather than a per-metric optimum, so that the comparison remains transparent and is not subject to post-hoc selection across the many logged configurations.
Following our finding that W 2 W_{2} is the strongest order for the convolutional backbone on the obstacle benchmarks and remains highly competitive on the anomaly benchmarks, we use the second-order configuration λ 𝒲 2 = 1.0 \lambda_{\mathcal{W}_{2}}=1.0 , λ MSE = 0.45 \lambda_{\text{MSE}}=0.45 , λ Dice = 0.75 \lambda_{\text{Dice}}=0.75 , λ KL = 0.0 \lambda_{\text{KL}}=0.0 .

我们比较我们的方法与基于不确定性的7个基线,即基于采样(Ensemble, MC Dropout),基于输出(Maximum Softmax, Entropy),以及对抗性样本/基于梯度的方法(PGN, ODIN, Mahalanobis).
LostAndFound和RoadObstacle21的结果见表1,鱼类景观和RoadAnomaly21的结果见表2。
对于所有数据集,我们报告一个单一的、固定的DeepLabV3+配置,而不是每个度量的最佳配置,这样比较就保持透明,并且不会在多个登录配置中进行选择。
我们发现W2 W_{2}是障碍基准上最强的革命骨干,在异常基准上仍然具有很强的竞争力,之后我们使用二等配置 λW2 = 1.0\lambda_{\mathcal{W}_{2}}=1.0,λMSE = 0.45\lambda_{\text{MSE}}=0.45,λDice = 0.75\lambda_{\text{Dice}}=0.75,λKL = 0.0\lambda_{\text{KL}}=0.0.

blocks.en:
While gradient- and adversarial-based methods achieve higher performance on RoadObstacle21 and Fishyscapes, our method reaches competitive results without requiring additional backward passes or input distortions.
Compared to the uncertainty-based baselines, our approach outperforms most sampling-based methods while relying on a single forward pass rather than multiple stochastic samples.
For instance, on RoadAnomaly21 our method surpasses the strongest baseline PGN in AuPRC (57.9 vs. 42.8) while requiring substantially lower computational overhead. This combination of strong anomaly-ranking performance and minimal inference cost makes the approach particularly well suited to safety-critical, resource-constrained deployment.
blocks.zh:
虽然以梯度和对抗性为基础的方法在 " Road Obstacle21 " 和 " Fishyscapes " 上取得了较高的业绩,但我们的方法取得了竞争结果,而不需要额外的落后通行证或输入扭曲。
与基于不确定性的基线相比,我们的方法比大多数基于取样的方法要好,同时依赖一个单一的前进通道,而不是多个有花样的样本。
例如,在Anomaly21公路上,我们的方法超过了AuPRC最强的基准PGN(57.9对42.8),同时需要大幅度降低计算间接费用。 这种做法结合了强大的反常级别业绩和最低的推论费用,使得这种方法特别适合安全关键和资源受限的部署。

blocks.en:
The two architectures behave fundamentally differently.
SegFormer is remarkably stable: the average mIoU stays within a narrow band of 80.54 % 80.54\% – 80.61 % 80.61\% across all three orders, and every configuration remains above 80.09 % 80.09\% , regardless of order or loss weighting, so that in-distribution accuracy is essentially preserved throughout the entire ablation.
This indicates that the in-distribution accuracy of SegFormer is essentially decoupled from the specific choice of Wasserstein order and from the surrounding regularization.
Thus, the substantial differences in OOD detection performance observed across SegFormer configurations are therefore obtained without any measurable cost to segmentation quality, making the backbone comparatively robust and straightforward to calibrate.
blocks.zh:
两种建筑的行为根本不同.
SegFormer非常稳定:平均mIoU保持在80.54 % 80.54 % — 80.61 % 80.61 % — —所有三种订单的狭长带内,而且无论顺序或减重,每个配置都保持在80.09 % 80.09 % 以上,因此分配的精度基本上在整个衰竭过程中都得到了保存。
这表明SegFormer的分布精度基本上与Wasserstein命令的具体选择和周围的正规化脱钩.
因此,在SegFormer配置中观察到的OOD检测性能的巨大差异是在没有分化质量的可衡量成本的情况下取得的,使得骨干相对坚固而直截了当地可以校正.

blocks.en:
DeepLabV3+ exhibits different behavior.
Average mIoU varies considerably across orders, from 67.67 % 67.67\% for W 1 W_{1} down to 56.14 % 56.14\% for W 2 W_{2} and back up to 66.88 % 66.88\% for W 3 W_{3} , an 11 11 percentage point drop for the very order that we identified as the strongest choice for OOD detection on this backbone.
Within each order, the spread between the weakest and strongest loss-weighting configuration is an order of magnitude larger than for SegFormer, reaching 24.98 24.98 percentage points for W 1 W_{1} (range [ 52.12 % , 77.10 % ] [52.12\%,77.10\%] ) and 20.50 20.50 points for W 3 W_{3} (range [ 55.84 % , 76.34 % ] [55.84\%,76.34\%] ).
Even W 2 W_{2} , the most stable order on this backbone, still spans 11.53 11.53 points ( [ 51.13 % , 62.66 % ] [51.13\%,62.66\%] ).
This sensitivity indicates that DeepLabV3+ segmentation quality is tightly entangled with the choice of Dice, KL, and residual MSE weighting, so that a loss configuration selected for strong OOD detection can incur a substantial and difficult-to-predict penalty in in-distribution accuracy, in contrast to SegFormer, where the two objectives can effectively be tuned independently.
blocks.zh:
DeepLabV3+展现出不同的行为.
平均mIoU在各种订单中差异很大,从67.67% 67.67%的W 1 W_{1}下降到56.14%的W 2 W_{2}再回到66.88 % 66.88 %的W 3 W_{3}, 也就是我们确定在这个骨干上最强的OD检测选择的顺序,下降了11个11个百分点。
在每一顺序中,最弱和最强减重配置之间的相差比SegFormer大,达到24.98 24.98个百分点,W1WQQ1}(幅度为[52.12%,77.10%] [52.12\%,77.10\%])和20.50 20.50分,W3WQQ3}(幅度为[55.84%,76.34%] [55.84\%,76.34\%])。
连这一骨干上最稳定的W 2 W_{2}仍然跨度为11.53 11.53分([51.13%,62.66%] [51.13\%,62.66\%].
这种灵敏度表明,DeepLabV3+分化质量与Dice,KL,和残留MSE权重的选择紧密地纠缠在一起,因此为强OD检测所选择的损失配置可以在分化精度上引起实质性而难以预测的处罚,与SegFormer形成对比,在SegFormer中,两个目标可以有效独立调和.

blocks.en:
Relative to the cross-entropy baselines, evidential training does incur a cost in in-distribution accuracy, but its magnitude again depends strongly on the architecture.
On SegFormer the reduction is modest and uniform: the mean mIoU drops from the baseline’s 84.00 % 84.00\% to roughly 80.5 80.5 – 80.6 % 80.6\% , a loss of about 3.4 3.4 percentage points that is virtually independent of the Wasserstein order and the loss weighting.
On DeepLabV3+ the average reduction is larger and highly configuration dependent, from a baseline of 80.09 % 80.09\% down to mean values between 56 % 56\% and 68 % 68\% , although the best individual configurations per order remain much closer to the baseline (up to 77.10 % 77.10\% for W 1 W_{1} and 76.34 % 76.34\% for W 3 W_{3} ).
Crucially, this in-distribution penalty is accompanied by a substantial gain in OOD performance: the same evidential models improve OOD detection over the corresponding cross-entropy and sampling-based baselines by large margins, most notably on the diverse anomaly benchmarks (Tables 1 and 2 ).
Thus, our method trades a comparatively small and, for SegFormer, nearly negligible decrease in in-distribution segmentation quality for a markedly stronger ability to flag OOD objects, which is precisely the trade off desired in safety-critical perception.
blocks.zh:
相对于跨纵横基线,证据训练的确在分配精度方面产生成本,但其规模再次强烈地取决于架构.
在 SegFormer 上, 减幅是适度而统一的: 平均mIoU从基线的84.00 % 84.00 % 下降到大约80.5 80.5 — 80.6 % 80.6 % , 减幅约为3.4 3.4个百分点,几乎独立于瓦瑟斯坦令和减重。
在DeepLabV3+上,平均减少量较大,且高度取决于配置,基线从80.09% 80.09%下降到56% 56%到68% 68%,尽管每个订单的最佳个人配置仍然远接近基线(W1 WQQ1}最高为77.10% 77.10%;W3 WQQ3}76.34% 76.34%)。
至关重要的是,这种分配处罚伴随着在OD性能方面的巨大收益:同样的证据模型使OD在相应的跨热带和以采样为基础的基线上以很大的边距改进了OD检测,最显著的是不同异常基准(表1和表2)。
因此,我们的方法相对而言是较小的,对于SegFormer来说,分配的分块质量几乎可以忽略不计,这样就明显更有能力标出OD物体,而这正是安全关键观念所期望的取舍。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This work introduced a Wasserstein based evidential framework for OOD segmentation.
Interpreting OOD objects as missing support in the training distribution motivates a geometry aware loss that avoids the overconfidence encouraged by Euclidean MSE.
Our ablations show that Wasserstein, Dice, and annealed KL regularization are complementary, with Dice providing the clearest reduction in FPR 95 .
blocks.zh:
这项工作引入了基于Wasserstein的OD分化证据框架。
将OOD对象解释为训练分发中缺少支持,激发出几何意识的丧失,避免了被Euclidean MSE所鼓励的过度自信.
我们的涂鸦表明,Wasserstein, Dice 和 Anealed KL 正规化是相辅相成的,Dice提供了最清晰的 FPR 95 的减少。

blocks.en:
The preferred Wasserstein order depends on the backbone.
For DeepLabV3+, W 2 W_{2} achieves the strongest overall detection on three of four benchmarks and is therefore the most reliable default. For SegFormer, replacing ReLU with softplus resolves missing evidence caused by predominantly negative logits.
With this adaptation, SegFormer leads on RoadObstacle21, RoadAnomaly21, and Fishyscapes, while DeepLabV3+ remains stronger on LostAndFound.
These results show that evidence activation and transport order should be selected jointly with the architecture.
blocks.zh:
首选的瓦瑟斯坦订单取决于骨干.
对于DeepLabV3+,W2 W_{2}在四个基准中的三个基准上实现了最强的整体检测,因此是最可靠的默认. 对于 SegFormer,用软加取代ReLU解决了主要由负对数引起的缺失证据.
有了这一改编,SegFormer领先于"Obstacle21"路,"Anomaly21"路和"鱼景"路;而"DeepLabV3+"则在"LostAndFound"上仍然更强大.
这些结果表明,证据激活和运输订单应与架构共同选择。

blocks.en:
Across LostAndFound and RoadObstacle21, the proposed method outperforms the evaluated deterministic and sampling based baselines on most comparisons, with particularly clear gains on RoadObstacle21.
It requires only a single deterministic forward pass and no auxiliary models, gradient access, or additional OOD training data.
blocks.zh:
在整个LostAndFound和RoadObstacle21中,拟议方法的绩效超过了根据大多数比较而评估的确定性和采样基线,在RoadObstacle21上尤其明显地取得了收益。
它只需要一个确定性的前进通道,没有辅助模型、梯度存取,也没有额外的OOD培训数据。

blocks.en:
The current Dirac transport cost assigns equal cost to all class confusions, and the analysis is limited to integer Wasserstein orders.
Future work can investigate learned semantic cost matrices, fractional orders, architecture specific evidence mappings, and extensions to open vocabulary and video segmentation.
blocks.zh:
目前的Dirac运输成本为所有类混淆分配等价成本,分析仅限于整数瓦瑟斯坦订单.
未来的工作可以调查所学的语义成本矩阵,分数顺序,架构特定证据映射,以及开放词汇和视频分解的扩展.
